latest_release.name: v4.0.0
latest_release.body:
NiceGUI 4.0 is a major release focused on cleaning up: it removes the APIs deprecated during 3.x, corrects a few defaults and catches up on the bundled JavaScript libraries. Nothing changes as fundamentally as the auto-index page did in 3.0, so most apps should only need small adjustments. Some changes don't raise any error, though, so please read the migration guide before upgrading.

### How to upgrade

1. Update to the latest 3.19 release, run your app and tests, and fix all deprecation warnings. They name the replacement for most of what is removed in 4.0.
2. Check the new minimum requirements below.
3. Upgrade and run a type checker like mypy or pyright. It flags many leftovers, e.g. `sanitize=None`, before the first run.
4. Go through the behavior changes below, because most of them won't show up as an error.

### New features and enhancements

- Support Python 3.15 (#6394 by @falkoschindler, @evnchn)
- Reduce the memory per connected client by about 14% and another 13% on a measured page, using `__slots__` on observable collections and dropping the bindable property registry (#6409, #6410, #6412, #6434 by @evnchn, @falkoschindler)
- Give text inputs a single empty state, so that the value type of [`ui.input`](https://nicegui.io/documentation/input) and related elements narrows to `str` (#6421, #6435 by @falkoschindler, @evnchn, @emmanuelprecieuxargent)
- Add a `pagination_controls` parameter to [`ui.table`](https://nicegui.io/documentation/table) that controls the pagination bar independently of `pagination`, so that assigning `table.pagination` later now shows the controls as well, and add `on_pagination_change` to `ui.table.from_pandas` and `ui.table.from_polars` (#6235, #6275 by @evnchn, @SaadZahem, @falkoschindler)
- Use "spawn" as the default start method of the [`run.cpu_bound`](https://nicegui.io/documentation/section_action_events#running_cpu-bound_tasks) process pool, because "fork" is unsafe in a threaded process (#6117, #6419 by @falkoschindler, @evnchn)
- Let `run.io_bound` and `run.cpu_bound` keep working in `app.on_shutdown` handlers and stop them from swallowing `task.cancel()` (#6420 by @falkoschindler, @evnchn)
- Allow plotly.py 7 for [`ui.plotly`](https://nicegui.io/documentation/plotly) (#6327, #6441 by @falkoschindler, @evnchn)
- Add the Quasar language packs `ckb`, `lb`, `sr-Cyrl`, `sq` and `ur-PK` (#6440 by @falkoschindler, @evnchn)

### Bugfixes

- Prevent custom `Object3D` and `Layer` objects created after an `await` from landing in another client's scene or map (#6345, #6361, #6401 by @evnchn, @falkoschindler, @wolfgang-aura)
- Fix router pages in `app.remove_route()` and `endpoint_documentation` with current FastAPI versions (#6373, #6416 by @falkoschindler, @evnchn, @Melvin0hd)
- Make objects with bindable properties picklable, e.g. as arguments to `run.cpu_bound`, and stop keeping their classes alive (#6412, #6434 by @evnchn, @falkoschindler)
- Let [`ui.leaflet`](https://nicegui.io/documentation/leaflet) add its layers before `await map.initialized()` returns, so that layer methods no longer return `None` (#6470 by @falkoschindler)

### ⚠️ Migration guide

#### Minimum requirements

| Requirement                 | 3.19                | 4.0                 | Ticket                                                     |
| --------------------------- | ------------------- | ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| Python                      | 3.10                | 3.11                | #6393 by @falkoschindler, @evnchn                          |
| FastAPI                     | 0.109.1             | 0.143.1             | #6373, #6416 by @falkoschindler, @evnchn, @Melvin0hd |
| Pillow (`matplotlib` extra) | 12.3                | 13.0                | #6467 by @falkoschindler |
| Chrome / Edge               | 111                 | 121                 | #6440 by @falkoschindler, @evnchn |
| Safari                      |
